title: Organize authorized Event Search Job results transiently in the local analyst workspace
goal: Demonstrate CAP-INV-007 class-0 multi-selection, source-family grouping, temporary pinning and independent Event Inspector navigation using only verified, owner-authorized Search Job references; exclude all persistent Class-2 mutations and exports.
invariants: CAP-INV-007 owns transient investigative workspace semantics; Search Job and Event source references remain Shared-owned; no new canonical Collection object.
The existing owner-validated Search Job is the only population of selectable refs. Client-side pins and selection MUST NOT grant access, persist or infer raw source data.
Independent existing server-owned Case/Timeline/typed-source reauthorization occurs on each explicit source open.

No persistent annotation, audited exclusion, Case result linking, export, Evidence creation or additional storage: OPEN-013 unaffected. Placement in demo is temporary and not production code ownership.
security_properties: Reject untrusted Wazuh grouping metadata outside completed SearchJob or repeated membership; never publish partial workspace on invalid result.
Clear selection/pins on new query/filter, and guard stale controls by Case, bearer, query revision and interval.
Tenant/environment/source ACLs remain exclusively owned by existing first-party server; no raw preview, secret or token in exported data.

migration.rationale: Browser-only ephemeral state; no database, stored object or schema.

rollback.strategy: Revert this bounded browser-only workspace; existing completed-job result list and source-open path remain.
verification: Prior normalized Search Job CLI/API and source authorization tests remain unchanged.
No authored Case or stored results exist.

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-007 full specification and current READ class-0 scope.
Existing parent Event Search first-party complete Search Job and Case/typed-source owner.
E10-INV-002G and E10-INV-110E verified runtime contracts; current PR #127 CI-green head is a Git dependency, not a business owner.
outputs: Transitory multi-selection and pinned refs for ONE completed Search Job, with visible Wazuh/JSONL grouping counts.
Explicit inspect-selected flow which independently reauthorizes existing source owner.
Fail-closed browser tests with foreign Wazuh metadata and stale selection reset.
Handoff stating partial CAP-INV-007 status and blocked/deferred Class-2 flows.
acceptance_tests: A completed first-party normalized search with one authorized Wazuh and one generic hit shows both groups, allows choosing and locally pinning only valid refs.
Changing current criteria or requesting another job destroys all selection and pins; stale control is inert.
Foreign or duplicated source grouping metadata causes no displayed results/workspace; no partial response.
Browser Go/Node Linux, Go macOS and Windows runtime test on exact SHA; mandatory engineering-kernel unchanged security floor and manifest validation.

performance_budget.rationale: At most 200 server-authorized SearchJob refs; grouping uses a Set with O(n) processing and transient browser memory.
metrics: No more than 200 selectable rows per completed SearchJob
Single-pass grouping O(n); no extra HTTP requests until explicit source open

definition_of_ready: Verified first-party SearchJob and independently authorized Case source-open are available.
Class-0 selection is permitted; all Class-2 operations remain excluded under OPEN-013.
Bounded one UI behavior with source group membership already available in authorized response.
definition_of_done: Exact SHA browser tests prove source-only completed Job membership, selections, stale invalidation and group counts.
New manifest + diff + CI and draft PR remain GitHub recoverable.
No full CAP-INV-007 acceptance, production IAM, persistent workspace, Export Job or Evidence claim.
